scope: Dependable shared master sound controls for existing producers, transport-safe mute and preference behavior; corrected permanent Team capability explanation. This is not complete music, navigation, hardware or whole-game acceptance.

acceptedObservations: Shared master controls with existing Solo, Versus, Studio preview and story producers retain their observed v0.58.0 scope; source regressions cover late playback, disposal, storage failures and concurrent preference events.
In v0.58.1 the permanent Team capability explanation remains separate from transient storage warning text during mute and volume edits, reload, paused edits and explicit Back.
The current public correction retains 36 original files across 14 correlated observations, including the clipped note and later successful inner scroll.
remaining: Team currently has no audio producer. Its shared preference controls and permanent capability note do not imply a delivered Team soundtrack.
No acoustic listening, native media.volume measurement, physical touch/controller or iPhone attenuation qualification is claimed.
Complete custom playlists across modes, album listening and offline custom-media acceptance remain P02-B; physical hardware and full browser qualification remain P18.
Natural story completion and Skip focus restoration remain P03/P07. Scroll/layout and complete native menu journeys remain P03/P05.
The Team note can require inner panel scrolling; the clipped observation is retained. Native viewport changes are browser observations, not physical-device tests.

Public correction observations cover keyboard preference edits, pointer entry, mouse scrolling, reload and displayed PAUSED/0:00; they do not establish private checkpoint equality, a complete Team round or fresh storage-refusal/offline tests.
The v0.58.1 source suites were complete hosted shard families, not a new local unsharded suite or local ordinary build. The repeated 4,333 cases are not 8,666 distinct tests.
